name: top
eval: const w=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); const a=window.__app, KN=0.514444, D=Math.PI/180; a.setQuality('high'); for (const k of Object.keys(a.overlays())) a.setOverlay(k, false); a.setForceParts(null); a.setTimeOfDay(13); a.scenario({ wind: { tws: 12*KN, twd: 225*D, gustiness: 0.2, shiftAmplitude: 0, shiftPeriod: 120, seed: 7 }, boat: { psi: 180*D, u: 3 }, controls: { helmMode: 'twa', helmTarget: 45*D } }); const b=a.sim.boat; const up={ e: Math.sin(225*D), n: Math.cos(225*D) }; a.setMarks([{ id: 'w', e: b.e + up.e*160 + 20, n: b.n + up.n*160, kind: 'windward' }]); a.setOverlay('laylines', true); a.setOverlay('track', true); a.setCamera('top'); document.getElementById('scene').dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel',{deltaY:1100,bubbles:true,cancelable:true})); await w(12000);
